question: Customer lost their card, what do I do?
answer: 1. Check the customer's original ID (national ID, passport or driving licence). Compare photo and signature with account records. Copies and expired documents are not accepted. [CONTROL] | 2. If someone other than the account holder reports the loss, do not capture a replacement. Ask them to call the contact centre to block the card, and the account holder to visit. [CONTROL] | 3. Have the customer complete and sign Form CB-01, stating when and where the card was last used. Countersign it. Do not block the card or capture a request without it. [CONTROL] | 4. Block the old card on the card system with reason code L1 (lost). Write the block reference on Form CB-01, attach it, and tell the customer the card is blocked. [CONTROL] | 5. Capture the replacement request on the card system, choosing the branch where the customer will collect the card. Charge the TZS 10,000 replacement fee. | 6. The supervisor checks the signed Form CB-01 with block reference is attached, then authorises. The supervisor must not authorise a request they captured themselves. | 7. The card centre produces the card within five working days. Record receipt of the card and PIN mailer under dual control and keep them in separate locked drawers. | 8. When the card arrives, check the customer's original ID again and have them sign the card collection register before handing over the card and PIN mailer. [CONTROL] | 9. Advise the customer to change the PIN at an ATM. Cards not collected within 60 days are destroyed under dual control and recorded in the stock register. [CONTROL]
